entities.name: Ignatius Peter VIII Abdalahad
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ignatius Peter VIII Abdalahad was patriarch of Antioch and all the East of the Syriac Catholic Church. He served as patriarch from 2001 to 2008, when he resigned and retired.
